title: Infinite-cardinal square and power identities
statement: Use the smaller universe of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. Fix a universe $\mathcal U$. Let $\theta\in\mathcal U$ be an infinite cardinal; multiplication and exponentiation below are cardinal operations. Then $\theta\cdot\theta=\theta$, $\theta<2^\theta$, and $(2^\theta)^\theta=2^\theta$.
